data.name: Avikrant
data.gender_notes: Avikrant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avikrant refers to one who transcends all boundaries and limitations. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of several deities and heroes who defied the laws of nature and achieved great feats. The name Avikrant carries the meaning “Bravery beyond limits” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avikrant usually hope their child will grow to embody bravery beyond limits and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and defiance against the odds.
data.etymology: Avikrant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bravery beyond limits.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avikrant total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Avikrant carries a profound cultural significance in Hinduism, particularly in the literature and epics. The name has been associated with numerous mythological figures like the mighty king Bharata, who renounced his throne and lived as an ascetic in the forest, and the eternally youthful god Krishna, who broke many societal norms and demonstrated the power of love and devotion. These characters, by transcending conventional boundaries, are celebrated as symbols of courage, determination, and rebellion against societal expectations.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Avikrant signifies liberation from the confines of the material world and the inner transformation necessary to attain enlightenment. The moniker inspires us to look beyond our daily constraints and limitations, surpassing our own mental and spiritual barriers. By embodying the spirit of Avikrant, one aspires to achieve a state of infinite freedom, peaceful existence, and deep connection with the divine. In essence, the name Avikrant reminds us of the boundless powers of the human spirit and the potential for personal growth that lies within each one of us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Avikrant signifies one who is beyond the limitations of the known reality, transcending the mundane through spiritual awareness and inner transformation. It embodies the journey towards the infinite, where the individual soul merges with the infinite divine consciousness.

vedic_reference.note: Avikrant is a compound Sanskrit name composed of two roots - 'Avigat' (meaning 'not present') and 'Krant' (meaning 'change'). This name can be interpreted as one who brings change when he arrives or someone who is not present yet in a situation.
